title: Student AI access, billing, independent response guard and VSCode assistant
description: Enable selected students, reserve/debit usage for tutor and guard, validate every draft before delivery, add admin configuration/balance controls and VSCode assistant. Model settings live in SQLite; API keys are encrypted.
acceptance_criteria: Server enforces access and budget, duplicate requests and parallel requests cannot overspend, refused drafts are not delivered, understanding is bound to the successful code snapshot and requires mechanism/trace/transfer evidence, extension and admin builds pass.
notes: Integrated on codex/student-ai-integration based on codex/ego-deploy-candidate (c93e96e). Reuses the server settings encryption key and native admin shell. Final server suite: 504 passed, 9 skipped; extension unit tests: 48 passed; TypeScript, Svelte, activation smoke, VSIX packaging, and browser UI checks passed. Includes real local mock-provider HTTP calls and review-before-delivery verification. Remote model credentials must be configured by the administrator; no production deployment performed.
close_reason: Implemented SQLite model configuration with encrypted provider keys, per-student access and billing, independent mandatory response guard, code-bound three-stage understanding defense and VSCode/admin interfaces. 351 tests passed, 6 skipped; TypeScript/Svelte builds and browser UI flows verified.

title: Configure Dolt remote for Beads synchronization

notes: Final synchronization was also rejected by automatic approval review because no concrete Dolt remote destination is configured/authorized. Awaiting the intended URL. A selected task-record export is included in the feature Git branch.
